Without kb_file_contract.md I cannot verify the produced files match the exact contract inbox-triage expects, and without kb_validator.py the mandatory pre-handoff validation step (an explicit part of the skill's own success criteria) cannot run. I still hand-authored a best-effort 7-file KB directly from the inline guidance in SKILL.md's section descriptions (simulating a plausible interview, since no live user could answer questions in this session) to see how far the task could get absent those files; the markdown files themselves were straightforward to write and are present and structurally reasonable, but the workflow's own defined completion step could not be executed, so the deliverable is not verified against the skill's real (missing) contract/validator.
